shortDescription: Philippine annual inflation accelerated to 7.2% in September from 6.1% in August, the statistics agency said on Tuesday.

children: Philippine annual inflation accelerated to 7.2% in September from 6.1% in August, the statistics agency said on Tuesday.
Economists in a Reuters poll had expected annual inflation of 6.6%.
The September reading was within the central bank's forecast of 6.4% to 7.4%.
The statistics agency said the rise in the inflation rate was driven by increases in prices of rice, electricity and other fuels, and transport.
The annual core inflation rate, which strips out volatile food and energy prices, was 4.7% last month.
